projects.title: Rashtriya Swasthya Sangathan
projects.subtitle: NGO Donation & Outreach Platform
projects.description: This NGO runs blood donation camps, mobile health clinics, old-age home support, and medical aid for underprivileged communities across India — but had no way for donors or volunteers to find them online. We built a full donation and outreach website: volunteer and donor sign-up, a cause-based donation flow, a news and events section, a photo gallery, and their impact numbers, all in one place. People can now find the organization, understand what they do, and give — without the NGO needing a developer on staff.

projects.title: SA Ethics Biotech
projects.subtitle: Certified Medical Device Manufacturer — Corporate Site
projects.description: SA Ethics Biotech is an ISO 9001:2015 & ISO 13485:2016 certified manufacturer and importer/exporter of medical devices and blood bank equipment, based in Delhi and Kanpur — but their website didn't reflect that level of credibility. We built a corporate site that presents their certifications, product lines, and company background the way B2B buyers and institutional clients expect from a certified manufacturer. It's now the first thing a hospital or distributor sees before doing business with them.

about.label: Who We Are
about.title: About
paragraphs: We build websites, booking systems, and everyday automation for **local businesses** — shops, restaurants, clinics, and service providers who need a professional online presence without hiring a full IT department.

We also build larger systems for **growing teams** — HR systems, scheduling software, internal dashboards, and custom workflows. That range means whatever your business needs, from a five-page website to a custom booking system, we can build it cleanly.
We keep things simple: clear answers, fair pricing, and a website or system that actually gets used — not a technical showcase nobody asked for.

aboutPage.heading: Working With Us
paragraphs: Every project starts with a discovery call, not a sales pitch — we want to understand what you actually need before talking about cost. From there you get a written, fixed-scope proposal, so the number you agree to is the number you pay.

Arpit Dwivedi, the founder, stays hands-on through the whole build — there's no handoff between an account manager and whoever actually writes the code. If you have a question mid-project, you're talking to the person building it.
We don't disappear after launch. Fixes, small updates, and follow-up work are part of how we work, not a separate retainer you have to negotiate into existence.

items.answer: It depends on scope. After a discovery call, we send a fixed-scope proposal so you know the cost upfront, before any work starts.

items.question: How long does a typical project take?
items.answer: A business website usually ships in 1–3 weeks; larger systems like booking platforms or custom software typically take 4–12 weeks depending on scope.

items.answer: Yes — we work remotely with clients worldwide.

items.question: What happens after launch?
items.answer: We stay reachable for fixes, updates, and follow-up work. This isn't a build-and-disappear engagement.

items.question: Do you build with AI and LLMs?
items.answer: Yes — from RAG pipelines and data workflows to LLM-integrated features and agentic automation, when it actually solves the problem.

faq.question: Is the Google Maps Business Finder free to use?
faq.answer: Yes. You get up to {maxResults} results per search and {maxSearches} searches per browser session, with no account or signup required.

faq.question: What data does it export?
faq.answer: Business name, address, phone number, website, rating, and hours — as a CSV, Excel (.xls), or JSON file.

faq.question: What happens when I hit the free session limit?
faq.answer: Searches are capped per session to keep the free tool fast and available for everyone. Refresh the page to reset your count, or reach out for premium access with higher limits.

faq.question: Does this replace the official Google Places API?
faq.answer: No. It's built for quick, low-volume manual lookups — agency prospecting, local SEO checks, one-off research — not as a production data pipeline.
